Qoder.name: Qoder
Qoder.seo_intro:
Qoder，面向真实工作的智能体平台。QoderWork 通过多智能体协同，与办公工具和数据深度连接。
让 AI 围绕真实业务持续完成理解、规划、执行、验证与交付，覆盖法律、金融、营销、HR、咨询等专业场景。
让每个人成为超级个体。
Qoder.seo_intro_en: Qoder, Agentic Platform for Real Work。Qoder enables AI to understand, plan, execute, and iterate on real-world tasks through multi-agent collaboration, long-horizon execution, memory, and deep codebase integration—until delivery is complete.

Z.ai.name: Z.ai
Z.ai.seo_intro: Z.ai 国际站 GLM Coding 提供 Lite / Pro / Max 三档个人编程订阅，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 20+ 编程工具，按月度 / 季度 / 年度订阅。
Z.ai.seo_intro_en: Z.ai international GLM Coding offers Lite, Pro, and Max individual coding subscriptions, supporting 20+ coding tools including Claude Code and Cursor, with monthly, quarterly, and annual billing.

BytePlus.name: BytePlus
BytePlus.seo_intro:
多款模型，一个套餐
可在最新的 Dola-Seed、GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi 和 GPT 之间自由切换，或启用自动模式以自动匹配最优模型。BytePlus 模型服务的可用性和功能因国家或地区而异。
BytePlus.seo_intro_en:
Multiple models, one plan
Freely switch between the latest Dola-Seed, GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi and GPT or enable auto mode to automatically match the optimal mode. The availability and features of the BytePlus Model Service may vary by country or region.

OpenCode Go 是一款低成本订阅服务：首月 $5，之后 $10/月。它提供充裕的额度，并让您能可靠地使用最强大的开源模型。

[*]充裕的限额和可靠的访问

OpenCode Go is a low cost subscription: $5 for your first month, then $10/month. It provides generous limits and reliable access to the most capable open source models.

ChatGPT.name: ChatGPT
ChatGPT.seo_intro: ChatGPT 是 OpenAI 推出的 AI 对话与编程助手，提供 Free、Go、Plus、Pro（5x/20x）及 Business 多档订阅。涵盖 GPT-5.5/5.6 系列模型、Codex 代码生成、Deep Research 深度研究、图像创作等能力，按月度订阅计费，面向个人用户与团队。
ChatGPT.seo_intro_en: ChatGPT is an AI assistant by OpenAI for conversation and coding. It offers Free, Go, Plus, Pro (5x/20x), and Business subscription tiers covering GPT-5.5/5.6 models, Codex code generation, Deep Research, image creation, and more, billed monthly for individuals and teams.
ChatGPT.training_opt_out: 设置 > 数据控制 关闭，或前往 privacy.openai.com

Claude.name: Claude
Claude.seo_intro: Claude 是 Anthropic 推出的 AI 助手平台，提供 Free/Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise 五档订阅套餐。内置 Claude Code 编程助手、扩展思考、联网搜索及多模型切换（Fable、Opus、Sonnet、Haiku），按 5 小时滚动窗口限制用量并叠加周上限，适合个人开发者、专业用户及企业团队。
Claude.seo_intro_en: Claude is an AI assistant platform by Anthropic, offering Free/Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise subscription tiers. Built-in Claude Code, extended thinking, web search, and multi-model switching (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku), with rolling 5-hour session limits plus weekly caps, suitable for individual developers, professionals, and enterprise teams.
Claude.training_opt_out: 设置 > 隐私 关闭「使用我的数据进行训练」（2025-10 起个人版默认可训练）
Claude.training_opt_out_en: Settings > Privacy, toggle off data training (consumer default-on since Oct 2025)
Claude.data_retention: 允许训练则保留 5 年，否则约 30 天
Claude.data_retention_en: 5 years if training allowed, otherwise ~30 days

Google Antigravity.name: Google Antigravity
Google Antigravity.seo_intro: Google Antigravity 是 Google 推出的智能体开发平台，提供 Individual 免费档与 Google AI Pro、Ultra 5x、Ultra 20x 三档付费订阅，可调用 Gemini 系列旗舰模型，按月计费，面向智能体与 AI 编程开发场景。
Google Antigravity.seo_intro_en: Google Antigravity is Google's agent development platform, offering a free Individual tier plus Google AI Pro, Ultra 5x, and Ultra 20x monthly subscriptions with access to flagship Gemini models, built for agent and AI coding development.

Grok.name: Grok
Grok.seo_intro: Grok 是 xAI（SpaceXAI）推出的 AI 助手，提供 SuperGrok Lite / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy 三档个人订阅及 Business 团队方案。具备深度推理、实时搜索、图像与视频生成、Grok Build 编程等能力，按月度/年度计费，面向个人与团队用户。
Grok.seo_intro_en: Grok is an AI assistant by xAI (SpaceXAI), offering SuperGrok Lite / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy individual tiers and a Business plan. Features advanced reasoning, real-time search, image & video generation, and Grok Build coding, billed monthly/yearly for individuals and teams.
Grok.training_opt_out: 设置 > 隐私与安全 关闭数据共享
Grok.training_opt_out_en: Settings > Privacy and safety, opt out
Grok.data_retention: 保留至服务所需或法定期限
Grok.data_retention_en: As long as necessary to provide the service

Cursor.name: Cursor
Cursor.seo_intro: Cursor 是一款 AI 代码编辑器，提供 Hobby（免费）、Pro/Pro+/Ultra 个人订阅及 Teams/Enterprise 团队方案。个人方案包含 API 用量池与第一方模型（Auto、Composer 2.5、Grok 4.5）充足额度，支持智能体编码、Tab 补全、云端智能体和 Bugbot 代码审查，适合从轻度尝鲜到重度智能体开发的各层级用户。
Cursor.seo_intro_en: Cursor is an AI code editor offering Hobby (free), Pro/Pro+/Ultra individual plans, and Teams/Enterprise plans. Individual plans include an API usage pool and generous first-party model usage (Auto, Composer 2.5, Grok 4.5), supporting agentic coding, Tab completions, cloud agents, and Bugbot code reviews — suitable for users from casual tinkering to heavy agent-driven development.
Cursor.training_opt_out: 开启 Privacy Mode（隐私模式默认关闭）
Cursor.data_retention: 开启 Privacy Mode 后零数据保留
Cursor.data_retention_en: Zero data retention with Privacy Mode

Google.name: Google
Google.seo_intro: Google 提供 Gemini 系列大模型的 API 按量计费服务，覆盖 Gemini 2.5 与 3.x 的 Pro、Flash、Flash Lite 等档位，支持长上下文与多模态能力，面向开发者集成场景，具体价格以 Google AI 官方页面为准。
Google.seo_intro_en: Google offers pay-as-you-go API access to the Gemini model family, covering Pro, Flash, and Flash Lite tiers across Gemini 2.5 and 3.x, with long-context and multimodal capabilities. See the official Google AI pricing page for details.

Trae.name: Trae
Trae.seo_intro: Trae 是字节跳动推出的 AI 智能开发环境（AI IDE），提供智能体编码、代码补全与项目级理解能力，支持 SOLO 模式自主完成开发任务，面向个人与团队开发者，订阅详情以 trae.ai 官方页面为准。
Trae.seo_intro_en: Trae is an AI-powered IDE by ByteDance, offering agentic coding, code completion, and project-level understanding, with SOLO mode for autonomous task completion. Built for individual developers and teams; see trae.ai for subscription details.

阿里云.name: 阿里云
阿里云.seo_intro: 阿里云通过 Model Studio（百炼国际站）提供 Qwen 系列大模型的 API 按量计费服务，覆盖 Qwen3 Max、Plus、Flash 与 Coder 等档位，支持长上下文与工具调用，面向国际开发者，具体价格以 Alibaba Cloud 官方页面为准。
阿里云.seo_intro_en: Alibaba Cloud offers pay-as-you-go API access to the Qwen model family via Model Studio, covering Qwen3 Max, Plus, Flash, and Coder tiers with long-context and tool-calling support. See the official Alibaba Cloud pricing page for details.

阿里云.data_retention: 调用数据经 AES-256 加密存储

阶跃星辰.name: 阶跃星辰
阶跃星辰.seo_intro: Step Plan 是面向智能体与编程场景的一体化能力订阅方案，通过标准化接口、多模型智能路由和开箱即用的多模态能力，帮助开发者低成本、高效率地构建智能工作流。
阶跃星辰.seo_intro_en: Step API · Stable · High-Performance · Easy Integration. Leading models and tools to accelerate the deployment of your next AI app.

快手StreamLake.name: 快手StreamLake
快手StreamLake.seo_intro: StreamLake溪流湖是快手toB视频云平台，提供领先的音视频AI解决方案。包含KAT-Coder智能编程助手、万擎大模型平台、视频云服务、直播云、点播云、实时音视频RTC等产品。基于前沿AI技术和音视频算法，为企业提供智能代码生成、视频处理、内容理解、智能审核等全链路服务，助力数字化转型。
快手StreamLake.seo_intro_en: Use KAT-Coder-Pro V2.5 with Claude Code and major IDEs for code generation, refactoring, and repository-level engineering tasks. Plans start at $5/month.
快手StreamLake.data_retention: 仅在必要期限及法定期限内保留，超期删除或匿名化
快手StreamLake.data_retention_en: Retained only as long as necessary or required by law, then deleted or anonymized

GitHub Copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
GitHub Copilot.seo_intro: GitHub Copilot 是 GitHub 推出的 AI 编程助手，提供 Free、Pro、Pro+、Max 四档订阅，深度集成 GitHub 与主流编辑器，支持代码补全、智能体编码与代码评审，按月度 premium 请求配额计量，面向个人与团队开发者。
GitHub Copilot.seo_intro_en: GitHub Copilot is the AI coding assistant from GitHub, offering Free, Pro, Pro+, and Max subscription tiers. Deeply integrated with GitHub and major editors, it supports code completion, agentic coding, and code review, metered by monthly premium request quotas.
GitHub Copilot.training_opt_out: 个人版可在 GitHub 设置中随时关闭数据用于模型训练；Business/Enterprise 数据不用于训练
GitHub Copilot.training_opt_out_en: Individual subscribers can opt out anytime in GitHub Settings; Business/Enterprise data is never used for training

Ollama.name: Ollama
Ollama.seo_intro: Ollama 支持在本地设备免费运行开源大模型，云端订阅提供 Pro、Max、Team、Enterprise 档位，可并发运行多个云端模型并按 5 小时会话窗口计量，本地数据不离开设备，适合注重隐私的开发者。
Ollama.seo_intro_en: Ollama runs open-source large language models locally for free, with cloud subscriptions across Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise tiers for running multiple cloud models concurrently under 5-hour session limits. Local data never leaves your device.
Ollama.training_opt_out: 无需退出：官方声明云端推理内容不用于训练，本地运行数据不离开设备
Ollama.training_opt_out_en: No opt-out needed: cloud prompts are processed transiently and never used for training; local runs stay on device
Ollama.data_retention: 账户信息在账户存续期间保留，可随时删除账户
Ollama.data_retention_en: Account data retained while active; delete your account anytime
